regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your favor of May 6th. It is rather hazey in my memory what your trouble was in December, since I get different cases often mixed. However, I feel you are taking a practil way for any and every "hopeless" -- so called. We'll pray for your intention and try as best we can to foster confidence in God - and in the intercession of our blessed Mother Mary.
